verdict.rationale: Analyzing user data is Claude's core function. The docs describe running Python and bash in a sandbox to analyze data and generate files, pre-built Excel/PDF/Word skills, and MCP/app connectors that bring user data into the conversation. The consumer apps also advertise running code and connecting apps and tools. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of an insights/suggestions workflow over user-uploaded data in the apps, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of data analysis.
